common.promptStandard: Purpose: four real wall-mounted makeup mirrors, targetProfileId makeup-mirror-wall, targetProfileVersion 1. Adapt the pinned project-authored tabletop heads in metres, +Y up and +Z toward the room. Remove base/post, translate retained vertices by [0,-.365,.038], add a closed .16 x .24 x .02m mounting plate with back Z=0, retain finite pane contours and fixed three-plane wings. Preserve wall mounting, warm-white spotlight and separate emissive housing. Bake identity transforms. Budget 2500 triangles/32 meshes/four materials. The measured Kenney candidate lacks the required pane and lamp mapping. Rebuild through the pinned exporter and validate actual loaded GLBs through the independent gate. Record source identities, frame edit, failures and limits.

mirrors.label: 圆形墙挂化妆镜
mirrors.prompt: Adapt pinned round mirror head, retain original contours and material, rigid transform plus closed wall plate. A circular 48-sided .18m radius pane, solid curved back and a continuous metal ring frame. Central base/post and a supported overhead warm-white lamp.
limitations: Circular silhouette uses an authored 48-segment polygon. Real reflection and scene illumination require runtime verification.
Wall-mounted source adaptation. Real wall/reflection/illumination require separate runtime evidence.

mirrors.label: 灯框墙挂化妆镜
mirrors.prompt: Adapt pinned lit-frame mirror head, retain original contours and material, rigid transform plus closed wall plate. A real .40 x .36m rectangular pane surrounded by a broad cream metal light-fixture frame and a separate overhead diffuser. Closed back, central pedestal and actual lamp bridge.
limitations: Broad fixed frame and overhead warm-white diffuser. No variable color temperature.
Wall-mounted source adaptation. Real wall/reflection/illumination require separate runtime evidence.

mirrors.label: 拱形墙挂化妆镜
mirrors.prompt: Adapt pinned arch mirror head, retain original contours and material, rigid transform plus closed wall plate. An actual .34m wide arch with straight lower sides, bottom at Y=.18m, upper arc centre Y=.38m and top Y=.55m. Use 24 upper-arc segments, a matching solid back and continuous metal ring.
limitations: Arched top is a finite 24-segment arc. No bending or deformation state.
Wall-mounted source adaptation. Real wall/reflection/illumination require separate runtime evidence.

mirrors.label: 三折墙挂化妆镜（固定展开）
mirrors.prompt: Adapt pinned tri-fold mirror head, retain original contours and material, rigid transform plus closed wall plate. Three genuinely distinct mirror planes. Central .28 x .37m pane, two .14 x .37m side wings yawed inward by 30 degrees, real thick back plates, recessed rims and closed hinge supports. Fixed open pose preserves unobstructed reflection interiors.
limitations: Fixed three-plane opening geometry. No movable hinge or folding state. Three real reflection passes require a host explicitly admitting three faces.
Wall-mounted source adaptation. Real wall/reflection/illumination require separate runtime evidence.

editableRanges.effect: Changes the real round frame contour and volume while preserving its mirror plane and all shared functional fields. Other model bytes remain identical. Every variant must pass the same geometry admission.
